EC1: - Unstable medical condition as indicated by history, physical exam, [OR] and/or laboratory findings
EC2: - Presence of non-CVD conditions likely to be fatal within 12 months (e.g., metastatic cancer)
EC3: - Severe cognitive impairment: Short Blessed screening with a score of 13 or greater or cannot consent (as indicated by medical record)
EC4: - Long-term care resident at admission [AND] with [NOT] no plans to return to independent living
EC5: - anticipates [NOT] inability to return for required reassessments at 3, 6 and 12 months
EC6: - long-term care residents at admission [AND] with [NOT] no plans to return to independent living.
